reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates with the QQ official bot platform for bidirectional messaging, agent session handling, media exchange, QQ API access, and optional external HTTP notifications.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 官方机器人，支持消息收发、会话管理、媒体交互及可选的外部推送接口。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QQ official bot platform with messaging, session management, media interaction, and an optional external push API.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QQ official bot platform
Receives and sends QQ channel, group, and direct messages
Creates and persists agent sessions and conversation context
Proxies authenticated QQ Open Platform REST API calls
Exposes an optional bearer-authenticated HTTP API for external text pushes
Presents agent approval and question prompts through QQ interactions
